title: If you are in a similar frame of mind as my wife then this the tour for you too!
text:
My wife was none too keen to wander the Alcazar following a guy with a flag and a horde of other people traipsing behind so I searched for an alternative and came upon a small group guided tour and signed up. It was to be the best holiday decision I've ever made.
The group consisted of just nine people and hosted by the lovely Barbara who spoke impeccable English and imparted a vast amount of history, culture and knowledge of the Alcazar that even my wife, who is sometimes underwhelmed with cultural visits, enjoyed the tour immensely!

title: Discover the real story of Alcazar Palace, Seville
text: A wonderful experience. Antonio our guide was superb and his knowledge of history about Seville and Alcazar Palace was second to none. We highly recommend this trip it was an  in-depth 2 hour tour, we were a small group of four, so Antonio gave us his full attention. The palace itself is beautiful and steeped in history and tradition with buildings of different styles, our favourite being the Islamic with all the intricate carvings and water features. It was lovely to have free time to wander back around the palace and take in the stunning gardens. Do not miss this tour it is well worth it.
